spec.title: Neon Ring Run
spec.tagline: Glide a rain-slick avenue through magenta, cyan, and gold transit rings.

world.basePrompt: A rain-soaked cyberpunk avenue stretches ahead at night, its wet asphalt mirroring magenta, cyan, and gold neon. Towering glass skyscrapers flank the street, their facades glowing with pink light panels and cool blue vertical strips. Massive circular transit rings span the road in sequence: a huge magenta ring, a cyan ring, and a smaller golden ring beyond, all mounted on dark steel gantries. Rooftop trees and warm window light soften the concrete edges. Mist hangs between distant spires, and the avenue continues forward into a glowing vanishing point of stacked rings and shimmering rain.

landmarks.description: Huge magenta neon ring spanning the avenue on a steel gantry
Mid-distance cyan neon ring between the towers
Smaller golden ring glowing far down the street
Rain-slick avenue reflecting pink and blue neon

spec.cartridgeLine: Thread the neon rings above the rain-mirrored avenue before the lights fade.
